chronos.scope: Real PMData inner-validation only; no final selection, Apple transfer or clinical inference.

chronos-report.scope: Reviewed narrative, model revision/license and original inference scope.

encoders.scope: Frozen representations plus trained ridge heads; development validation only.

encoder-report.scope: Original trained-head methods, mask/device/overlap and conflicting WBM license limits.

baseline.scope: Real baseline validation, coverage and original source/config/artifact receipts.

baseline-report.scope: Denominators, paired support, no final winner; PMData illness status unknown.

baseline-paired.scope: Paired common-target comparisons; differing coverage cannot be ignored.

baseline-index.scope: Public private-packet digests, no participant membership; outer test sealed.

anomaly.scope: Observed symptom-free control burden with scored and all-observed denominators; floating clock, no illness probability.

anomaly-acceptance.scope: Source-bound aggregate replay/independent raw reconciliation acceptance.

illness.scope: Selected retrospective cohort development, survey-observation selection; no validated product probabilities.

illness-replay.scope: Reload/decision parity evidence only; no clinical accuracy implication.

api.scope: Real PMData inner-validation HTTP/direct/packet comparison; separate synthetic lifecycle.

replay.scope: Saved real result with original immutable identities; no live inference.

browser.scope: Original separate replay consumer numeric/time/geometry evidence; full app integration false.

rehearsal-report.scope: Current versus historical replay receipts; missing #17/#20/#21/full #22 gates.

runbook.scope: Source runbook; commands are future rehearsal instructions, not execution proof.

privacy-report.scope: Generated transport/deletion and separate SSH removal proof; no real personal consent, physical-media erasure or GPU inference proof.

privacy.scope: Generated independent private storage/remote cleanup checks.

apple.scope: Generated native/HTTP transport performance on exact CPU receipt; unchanged gates, DEVICE_SHIFT, unvalidated real Apple transfer.

final.scope: Development tooling only; no selected model, test authority or accepted superseded recovery packet.

product.scope: All required product capabilities and research/full scope completion gates.

roadmap.scope: Required M0–M4 gates; M5 optional extensions cannot replace required scope.

evaluation.scope: Participant/temporal protocol, separate clinical labels, healthy burden and one-person retrospective limitation.

contracts.scope: Authoritative contract semantics, modes/provenance and unavailable/simulation separation.

research.scope: Source access and model/source license/citation summaries.

pmdata-license.scope: Binding stricter noncommercial source license; source citation.

stanford-license.scope: Public research access, no explicit data license; source citation.
